Pricing questions

A conversation is a support ticket, a customer email, a transcribed call or an online review (Google, Trustpilot, etc.). Each individual message or review counts as one unit.

You get a notification at 80% of your quota. Beyond it, new analyses are queued until the next billing cycle or until you upgrade your plan.

Yes on monthly plans — immediate upgrade or downgrade, with no penalty. Yearly plans are a 12-month commitment and cannot be cancelled before the end of the term.

Your data is hosted in France and encrypted in transit and at rest. It is never used to train our models. A DPA is available on request from the Scale plan.

These integrations are in beta, on request, from the Growth plan. Contact us to activate priority access.
